T: The Green Place grows peaches. The Wasteland grills.
D: Young Furiosa is taken from the Green Place and has to fight her way back across the Wasteland.
P: Serve the peaches when Furiosa plants the seed.
S: the green place Furiosa grew up in
Radishes, baby carrots, cucumber and snow peas from the garden with whipped feta and herbs.
the Bullet Farm, all smoke and noise
Smoked sausages sliced and charred in a hot pan, tossed with barbecue sauce and served on toothpicks.
bread cooked on hot steel in the Wasteland
Simple yoghurt flatbreads cooked on a smoking hot pan until blistered, brushed with garlic butter.
M: the long haul across the Wasteland
Lamb chops marinated in rosemary, garlic and lemon, grilled hot on the barbecue with charred corn.
Gastown, where everything is black with fuel
Chicken thighs rubbed with a dark spice mix of paprika, garlic and pepper, seared until blackened, with slaw.
W: the peach seed Furiosa carries all the way
Peaches halved and grilled cut side down until caramelised, drizzled with honey and thyme and served with vanilla ice cream.
K: Cold milk blended with vanilla ice cream and a little honey until thick.

s.note: the green place Furiosa grew up in
s.how: Trim 1 bunch radishes and 1 bunch baby carrots, slice 1 cucumber into spears and string 150g snow peas. Whip 200g feta with 3 tbsp olive oil and lemon until smooth. Arrange the vegetables around the feta like a fresh garden.

s.note: the Bullet Farm, all smoke and noise
s.how: Slice 500g smoked sausages into thick rounds. Char in a hot pan for 4 minutes until blistered, then toss with 4 tbsp barbecue sauce until sticky. Serve on toothpicks straight from the pan.

m.note: the long haul across the Wasteland
m.how: Marinate 12 lamb chops for 1 hour with 2 sprigs chopped rosemary, 3 garlic cloves, the juice of 1 lemon and 3 tbsp oil. Grill over high heat 3 minutes a side. Grill 4 corn cobs for 10 minutes alongside and brush with butter.

w.note: the peach seed Furiosa carries all the way
w.how: Halve and stone 4 peaches. Brush the cut sides with a little oil and grill cut side down for 4 minutes until charred and soft. Drizzle with 2 tbsp honey warmed with thyme and serve with 500ml vanilla ice cream.

d.how: Blend 1L cold milk with 500ml vanilla ice cream and 2 tbsp honey until thick and frothy. Pour into 4 tall glasses and serve straight away.
